## Tax Line

What a sale owes one agency at one rate of one tax code: `code`, `agencyId`, `ratePpm`, `taxableMinor` (the sale's lines under that code) and `taxMinor` (taxable times the rate, rounded to the cent). A sale's `calculateTax` writes them, and its `post` checks them.

```ts
import { TaxLine } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-tax-codes';
```

### Example
The tax lines on `Invoice/draft-taxed-wa`.
